_README_Auth: Sprint-7 U5 — AddShopFlowDefaults registers JwtBearer kernel-wide so every module API (including Outbound) validates tokens issued by Auth.Api. DevSecret must match Auth.Api byte-for-byte. Outbound.Api is the sole hub-host process; the OnMessageReceived handler converts ?access_token=... on /hub requests to context.Token and strips the parameter from the URL before request logging (SEC-001).
